title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA-1999 9.10.3 During 1999, around Rs. 35 crores were seized by the CBI as against Rs. 3.6 crores in 1998 under this Act. The State/UT vigilance officials seized property to the tune of 18.5 crores in the various seizures connected with corruption charges. In the cases investigated by CBI, in 1999, against 855 persons regular departmental action was taken, where as, in the States/UTs regular departmental actions were initiated, against only 252 persons. The punishment awarded to various public servants in the cases handled by CBI included 35 dismissals, 9 removals, 225 major and 275 minor punishments in 1999. A look in the profile of the public servants involved in States/UTs reveals that 1100 gazetted officers(716 group 'A', 384 group 'B' officers) 3,056 NGO's and 752 privately employed were involved in such cases. There were 22 dismissals, 2 removal from service. 23 major, 73 minor punishment were awarded to the public servants in the State/Uts during this year.
